name: SurveyMonkey
summary: Survey and feedback platform: build surveys, collect responses at scale and analyze results for market research, CX and employee feedback. A native Salesforce integration pushes responses straight into Salesforce, triggers workflows off the answers themselves (churn-risk follow-up or an NPS detractor landing on a rep's desk, for instance) and ties feedback back to accounts and pipeline, so sales and CS read it inside the tool they already work in rather than in a separate reporting dashboard.
best_for: teams that need research-grade survey logic (skip logic, randomisation, quotas) with compliance (HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2) and 200+ integrations
skip_if: you just need a simple form (Google Forms is free) or you're cost-sensitive with high response volumes — the overage fees add up
honest_knock: The free tier is a teaser. Response caps on the self-serve plans trigger $0.15-per-response overages (US rate; Enterprise contracts set their own limits) that become a hidden cost on big studies. Branding and customisation are limited, and a lot of the good analytics and logic sit behind higher tiers.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month, billed annually
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-01 in surveymonkey.com/pricing.md, whose header now dates the content 2026-09-22, and on surveymonkey.com/pricing/ as served to a euro storefront) Team plans are billed annually and need three or more users; pricing.md no longer lists any monthly Team variant. Every Team seat costs the same, the first one included: in the US table Team Advantage Annual is $360 a user a year and Team Premier Annual $1,104, the $30 and $92 a month the SurveyMonkey partner team quoted by email on 24 September 2026, so three seats come to $1,080 or $3,312 a year. Euro storefronts read €360 and €900 a user a year, shown on the page as €30 and €75 a month. The euro pricing page states the included responses: 50,000 a year on Team Advantage and 100,000 on Team Premier, counted across all surveys and users; Enterprise (five or more users, custom quote) has a custom limit. Overage above the limit is priced per storefront: $0.15 a response in dollar countries, €0.10 in euro countries, £0.15 in sterling; SurveyMonkey Audience responses are sold separately. Individual plans in the US table: Standard Monthly $149 a month, Standard Annual $300 a year (US, GB and AU only, not offered to churned Basic users), Advantage Annual $468 and Premier Annual $1,668 a year. The partner team quoted Standard Monthly at $99 a month two days after this edition of pricing.md, so confirm that one at checkout. The free Basic plan allows 10 questions per survey, and pricing.md now shows its response limit as 10 outside Canada, where Basic users keep 25.
